submitted.rationale: Index 27 (In 0.17 / Sb 0.83) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0248%. EQE rose with Sb content: 0.0106% at index 5 and 0.0240% at index 19. Only a single-phase rutile / Sb2O4-type pattern appears in the Sb-rich films. MACE puts that phase essentially on the hull, and MEGNet predicts a gap below the 2.7 eV photon energy.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of 0.0106%. XRD shows an In2O3 bixbyite + rutile mixture near In11Sb3O24, despite a predicted 1.9 eV gap.
Measured EQE of 0.0240%, slightly below index 27.
The GP suggested it, but its predicted mean was lower than the measured Sb-rich values. The data favoured extrapolating toward high Sb.

consultations.verdict: Support: In11Sb3O24 (mp-674374) is on the MACE hull and MEGNet HSE gap 1.91 eV < 2.7 eV photon energy; its composition (In 0.786) matches index 5, whose XRD shows a mixed bixbyite/rutile-like pattern with extra peaks beyond the Sb-rich rutile pattern.

Moderate support: the Sb-rich film XRD best matches Sb2O4-type (mp-1819). MEGNet HSE gives it a 1.67 eV gap, which should absorb at 2.7 eV. The In-rich index 5 gave very low EQE (0.011%), so I am probing the other end of the line. Index 19 sits near In3Sb5O12 (in the earlier receipts: MACE hull distance 0.018 eV/atom, predicted gap 2.77 eV), and there the rutile phase dominates.

Support: SbO2 (mp-1819, Sb2O4-type) is essentially on the hull (0.0035 eV/atom) and is the best XRD match for the Sb-rich films. With a predicted gap of about 1.7 eV, it can absorb 2.7 eV photons. Measured EQE rose from 0.011% (In 0.79) to 0.024% (Sb 0.63), so I am extrapolating to the Sb-rich end.
